screens.name: 01-home
screens.prompt: Use case: design exploration / UI mockup. Generate one complete polished flat front-on screen for GameChangersAI OS, a handheld game platform on the M5Stack Tab5, 5-inch 1280x720 landscape display. This is the new HOME / GAME LIBRARY screen. 16:9 image, preferably 1536x864 or 1280x720. No tablet/device frame, no perspective. Art direction: the optimistic 1995 film Hackers cyberspace energy matured into an extremely usable contemporary handheld console. Ink navy #07121C, slightly lighter #122735 surfaces, warm white #F4FAFC text, readable pale blue #B4CBD5 secondary text, electric cyan #55E6EC as single interaction accent. NO Windows chrome, no bevels, no microscopic fake telemetry, no scanlines over text, no neon text glow. Big readable labels, around 28-32 px at 1280 wide, 42 px title, spacious 80-pixel-high touch controls. Use the supplied joystick logo as a small brand reference in the header; preserve the identity but simplify its placement. Top: small logo and GameChangersAI, right clean battery and storage indicators. Left slim 200px navigation with Home, Games, Multiplayer, Files, Settings. Main workspace title 'Your games'. One broad selected feature row with original low-poly cyan cyberspace arcade artwork on the right and title 'Byte Buddy' on an opaque calm left region, subtitle 'Explore. Collect. Decode.', substantial cyan 'Play' button. Below exactly three large selectable game-cover tiles: 'Maze Chase', 'Blast Circuit', 'Solitaire' with tasteful original game illustrations. Selected card has unambiguous cyan outline and small play icon. Plenty of negative space. Footer plain 'A Play   B Back' and OS 0.43. Sample battery '72%' is illustrative mock data. Avoid desktop windows, heavy card mosaic, unreadable microtext. Make it exciting through the artwork and composition, calm and highly legible through the typography. This is a visual concept, not a photograph.

edits.prompt: Edit the FIRST attached GameChangersAI OS Home screen, preserving its exact polished navy/cyan interface, layout, logo, all functional navigation, labels, sizes and controls. Make only these changes: remove the invented advertising slogans 'PLAY A BRIGHTER TOMORROW', 'SMALL BOT BIG WORLDS', and the sidebar slogan 'PLAY CREATE SHARE BELONG', leaving calm empty space in their places. Replace only the Blast Circuit game thumbnail with a colorful top-down bomb arena with blocks and small player characters, matching the Blast Circuit cover in the SECOND attached Games screen. Blast Circuit is a bomb arena game, not a space shooter. Keep the first Home image as the output, retain Byte Buddy hero robot, Maze Chase, Solitaire, status bar and Play button. No added text or slogans.
